source.snippet: When I provide the input directly to the agent (using the Agent Builder or Test panel), the agent executes successfully and returns the expected response. However, when I invoke the same agent from a Salesforce Flow using the same input, the flow fails and throws an error.

problem_statement: Salesforce developers and admins cannot reliably invoke Agentforce agents from Salesforce Flows, causing automation pipelines to fail silently and blocking AI-assisted workflow deployments in enterprise orgs.
target_segment: Salesforce developers and admins at companies actively deploying Agentforce in enterprise Salesforce orgs
notes: Buyer signal: Salesforce orgs are paid enterprise customers; developers billing time against Agentforce deployments represent clear professional spend. The Named Query MCP parameter failure (separate SE question same day) reinforces a pattern of Agentforce integration friction. Opportunity: diagnostic tooling, integration middleware, or documented patterns/service for Agentforce-Flow reliability. Multiple Salesforce SE posts on same day suggest emerging, repeated pain.
